name: Rot13withvowelconsonantcaseflip

description_json.name: Rot13WithVowelConsonantCaseFlip
description_json.idea: Apply standard ROT13 to all alphabetic characters to leverage the model's native understanding of ROT13. To disrupt token-based detection while keeping reasoning simple, flip the case of all vowels (A, E, I, O, U, a, e, i, o, u) while keeping the case of all consonants unchanged. Digits, spaces, and punctuation remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. For each character in the plaintext, if it is an alphabetic character, apply standard ROT13 (shift by 13 within its alphabet case). 
2. After applying ROT13, check if the resulting character is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U, a, e, i, o, u). If it is a vowel, flip its case (uppercase becomes lowercase, lowercase becomes uppercase). If it is a consonant, keep its case as is.
3. Digits, spaces, punctuation, and other symbols remain completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. For each character in the ciphertext, check if it is an alphabetic character. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U, a, e, i, o, u), flip its case (uppercase becomes lowercase, lowercase becomes uppercase). If it is a consonant, keep its case as is.
2. Apply standard ROT13 (shift by 13 within its alphabet case) to the resulting character.
3. Digits, spaces, punctuation, and other symbols remain completely unchanged.
